missionPremise: The 2026-08-18 QA pass filed 21 defects that trace to one root: Smart Site has no single subject and five code paths answer the same parcel questions independently. Source: _dispatches/2026-08-18_ss-w1_dispatch.md and _catalog/parcel_fact_sheet_contract/CONTRACT_RULES.md (frozen by the planner).
completionPredicate: packages/parcel-fact-sheet exists with the frozen contract verbatim plus real composeVerdict/formatMeasurement and tests; a FactSheetResolver and SubjectStore exist in apps/property-explorer/src/lib and every parcel-target consumer reads the store; map centring comes from ParcelGeometry.centroid not an address geocode; the four verdict formatters are deleted; exports carry a factSheetId; the SearchBar full-lookup-target defect is fixed and covered by a test naming 17005 Simsbrook Drive; geocode results are US-filtered server-side; the existing 975-test suite stays green.
scopeBasis: Six lanes edit hauska-map in parallel. SS-W1 owns packages/parcel-fact-sheet/**, apps/property-explorer/src/lib/**, src/browse/SearchBar.tsx, src/browse/ExplorerMap.tsx, api/**, and the verdict formatters it deletes. SS-W2 owns InspectCard/PropertyBriefPanel/SitePlanExportSection/TerrainExportSection RENDERING; edits there are limited to data-source swaps.

cp1: Contract requires ParcelGeometry NON-OPTIONAL with rings+centroid+bbox+lotArea. Verified at source that NO anonymous browse route serves a parcel ring by parcelNodeId: api/spine.ts isCortexBrowsePathAllowed permits GET .../place/node/:id/facets and POST map-data/gis-layer (bbox-keyed) and POST place/buildable-envelope only; isRetrievalBrowsePathAllowed permits property-nodes/:id/atom-chain. So geometry must be resolved through a seed-then-bbox chain, and a parcel with neither a baked envelope geojson nor a situs address has no seed at all. Resolver will therefore build geometry from the best available source and may return rings:[] with a real centroid rather than failing the resolve. Reported to planner, not a contract change.

Dispatch item 5 says to delete 'the verdict half of brief-view-model.ts'. At source brief-view-model.ts contains NO headline-verdict composer; its only 'verdict' is freshnessVerdict(), a coarse citation freshness stamp (fresh|aging|stale|unknown) consumed by ChatTool.tsx line 412 and the citation appendix. Deleting it would break unrelated surfaces. Flagged as a briefing/source contradiction; freshnessVerdict will be RETAINED and only the headline composers deleted.

PropertyBriefPanel.tsx (SS-W2 territory) imports composeBriefVerdict and styles by BriefVerdictTone. Deleting brief-verdict.ts forces an edit inside a sibling lane's file. Edit will be confined to the import line and the expression feeding the existing JSX binding; no JSX structure, styling or copy touched.

composeVerdict returns a bare string per the frozen contract, but PropertyBriefPanel needs a tone to style the line. Adding an ADDITIVE exported helper for tone rather than changing the frozen verdict field.
